register_task: register a custom EmbodiedTask subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_task decorator
register_simulator: register a custom Simulator subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_simulator decorator
register_sensor: register a custom Sensor subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_sensor decorator
get_task: retrieve a registered EmbodiedTask class by name from the Habitat registry using get_task
get_simulator: retrieve a registered Simulator class by name from the Habitat registry using get_simulator
